key_concepts: Physical changes alter shape, texture, or size without changing composition
Crumpling and tearing paper are physical changes
Crushing sugar is a physical change
Heating sugar causes a chemical change
Chemical changes produce new substances with different properties
Mixing vinegar and baking soda is a chemical reaction
Gas bubbles indicate a chemical reaction between vinegar and baking soda
Burning paper would be a chemical change
Physical changes may leave the original material recognizable
